summary: Practise HAZID, permit-to-work and SIMOPS controls for oilfield operations. Explore the five-day intermediate course.
lede: Oil and gas safety training covers how to assess field hazards and verify controls before and during work. For HSE advisers, drilling supervisors and operations leads, this intermediate course develops practical skills in HAZID and bow-tie reviews, permit-to-work checks and coordination of simultaneous operations. It also addresses energy-isolation verification and occupational exposure controls, with exercises to create checklists and handover records for site procedures.
audienceIntro: Oil and gas safety courses suit professionals who make or support field-level decisions about hazardous work, worker health and control verification. This intermediate course is designed for people who already work with oil and gas operations or HSE responsibilities.
prerequisites: Prior work exposure to oil and gas operations or occupational health and safety responsibilities is expected. No coding or programming is required; exercises use supplied work scenarios and sample safety records.
